p: Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A triceps / hammer curl bar, a short bar formed into an open rectangular frame with two parallel neutral grip handles running across the inside, with short loading sleeves at each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A cambered bar, a long Olympic-length barbell whose centre section bends downwards in a pronounced drop on each side so the loaded sleeves hang below shoulder height, or a gently curved bow bar version.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A landmine, a heavy steel floor base or rack-mounted post with a rotating sleeve that pivots in all directions, holding one end of a barbell that rises at an angle with a single plate loaded on the far end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A power rack / squat rack, a tall four-post steel cage with holes punched up each upright, J-hooks holding a barbell at shoulder height, horizontal safety bars running front to back at waist height inside the cage and a pull-up bar across the top.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A home multi-gym, a single-stack steel home gym with a central weight stack, a padded seat with a chest press arm, a high pulley with lat bar, a low pulley at the front and a leg extension and curl roller pad at the base of the seat.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An adjustable bench, a padded weight bench with a long back pad that ratchets from flat to fully upright on a steel ladder, a separate adjustable seat pad, a wheeled front leg and a handle at the rear.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An incline bench station, a fixed incline back pad at about 30 to 45 degrees with a small seat, tall steel uprights behind the head holding a barbell, and a raised spotter platform at the rear.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A hip thrust bench, a low padded back support bench at knee height, with a curved pad for the upper back, a floor base the user sits on, and band pegs or a barbell resting across the hips area.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A bench leg extension / curl attachment, a pivoting steel arm attached to the front of a weight bench, with two pairs of foam rollers for the shins and a loading horn for plates at the end of the arm.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of heavy dumbbells (50 kg+), a rack of very large round dumbbells with thick plates welded to chunky knurled handles, the heaviest pairs at the end being much bigger than the others.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A steel mace, a long steel bar about 1 m long with a heavy steel ball welded to one end and a knurled shaft, standing upright on the ball end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A seated cable row, a long low padded bench running away from a weight stack, with an angled footplate at the stack end and a cable emerging from a pulley at foot height with a close-grip V handle.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A lat pulldown / low row combo, a single weight stack machine with a seat and thigh pads under a high pulley holding a lat bar, plus a low pulley and footplate at the front for seated rows.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A V-bar, a small triangular steel handle with two parallel neutral rubber-gripped handles side by side and a clip ring at the point of the V.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An ankle strap, a padded neoprene cuff with a hook-and-loop fastening and a metal D ring sewn on, designed to wrap around the ankle and clip to a low cable.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A rotary torso, a pin-loaded machine with a rotating seat, padded knee and chest pads and handles, which twists from side to side, with a weight stack at the rear.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An ab coaster, a steel frame with a curved rail on which a padded knee carriage slides up and down, with arm rests and handles at the top.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A rowing machine, a long horizontal rail with a sliding seat, angled footplates with straps, a handle on a chain at the front and a flywheel inside a fan housing or water tank.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An upright bike, an upright stationary bike with a saddle, pedals, handlebars and console on a sleek frame with an enclosed flywheel.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A cross-trainer, a machine with two long foot pedals tracking an oval path, moving handles linked to the pedals, and a console on a front upright.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A stair climber, a tall motorised machine with a revolving staircase of steps that rotate downwards like an escalator, side handrails and a console at chest height.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An upper body ergometer, a table-height pedestal with two crank handles that rotate around a central axle connected to a flywheel, and a display console, with a chair placed in front.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A turf track, a long strip of green artificial turf about 2 m wide and 20 m long laid flat on a gym floor, edged with white lane lines and distance markers.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A wall ball and target, a soft stitched vinyl medicine ball about 35 cm across, in front of a flat wall with a round target painted or mounted at 3 m height.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A plyo box, a three-height box with rectangular faces of different dimensions, made of plywood with a hand-hold cut-out on each side, or covered in thick foam with vinyl.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A weighted vest, a short tactical-style vest with front and back pockets holding flat steel weight plates, held on by wide hook-and-loop side straps.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A punch bag, a long cylindrical black leather heavy bag about 1.2 m tall hanging from a ceiling bracket by four chains joined to a swivel, with a pair of boxing gloves on the floor beneath.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A frame carry, a large rectangular steel frame with two long parallel side rails with handles, loading posts on each end and connecting cross members, sitting on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A log, a thick hollow steel cylinder about 30 cm across with two neutral handles cut into a recess in its middle and standard loading sleeves at each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An arm-over-arm pull, a loaded sled at the end of a long thick rope that passes over a low bench or seated platform, so the user pulls the rope hand over hand.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A pull-up bar, a straight knurled steel bar mounted horizontally above head height between two wall brackets or across the top of a rack, with angled neutral grip handles at each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A foot anchor / Nordic strap, a padded nylon strap with a foam ankle loop and a flat anchor tab that closes inside a door, alongside a low padded bar for hooking the feet under.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A fingerboard / hangboard, a wooden or resin board mounted on a wall above a doorway, with a row of edges, pockets and slopers of various depths along its face and a jug hold at each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A dip / weight belt, a curved padded leather or nylon belt with a heavy steel chain running from one end ring to the other with a carabiner, with a weight plate hanging on the chain.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A wrist roller, a short knurled steel bar with a length of rope wound around its middle and a carabiner at the end of the rope holding a weight plate.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An aerobic step, a low rectangular moulded plastic step about 1 m long with a ridged non-slip rubber top and stackable riser blocks under each end.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A massage ball, a small hard rubber ball the size of a tennis ball beside a double peanut-shaped ball made of two joined spheres.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of stretch strap, a long flat nylon webbing strap with a series of sewn loops along its length for the hands and feet.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A BOSU ball, a large inflated half-sphere of blue rubber about 60 cm across fixed to a flat rigid black plastic base with two handles cut into its rim.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of rehab parallel bars, two long parallel handrails about 3 m long on adjustable height posts, set about 60 cm apart on a flat base platform.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An isokinetic dynamometer, a large clinical machine with a padded adjustable chair with straps, a motorised dynamometer head on a column beside it and a lever arm with a shin pad, linked to a computer screen.
